description.value: Reynolds Hotel is a historic boutique hotel built in 1941 in Lillooet, BC, set against the backdrop of the Coast Mountain Range and Fraser Canyon. Extensively renovated with locally cut and milled wood floors and antiques throughout, it blends period character with modern room amenities. Rated one of the top 10 sleeps on the Sea-to-Sky Corridor by 99 North Magazine, it also features an on-site restaurant and pub serving home-cooked meals.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully for the front page and contact page, confirming the hotel is open and operating. Room amenities listed on the front page confirm wireless high-speed internet, but neither bike storage nor staff bike procedures are mentioned anywhere in the accessible content; the /amenities/ subpage was blocked by Incapsula bot protection, so the full amenities list could not be verified. The on-site Reynolds Restaurant and pub are confirmed from website text as sources of nearby evening food.
concerns: Several subpages (/amenities/, /image-gallery/, /fishing/, /comments/) were blocked by Incapsula bot protection, so the full amenities list could not be verified — bike storage and other facilities may exist but are unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with active website, confirmed contact details, and on-site food and beverage. A clear and useful stop for touring cyclists in Lillooet.
